results.title: 'I knew we'd lose 3-0': Wasim Akram tears into Pakistan cricket setup
results.description: Wasim Akram states Pakistan cricket's deep issues extend beyond the national team. He notes problems exist in batting, bowling, and fielding across the sport. Akram believes the domestic structure lacks necessary systems and stability. Inconsistent decisions by the cricket board have worsened the situation. Fixing Pakistan cricket requires patience and stability throughout the entire system.
